programs.title: Dhol
programs.desc: Four young loafers wish to simplify their life by wooing a loaded heiress. Unfortunately, there's only one rich girl in the neighbourhood. The boys scamper to woo her first, not knowing that their efforts would lead them right into a murder mystery.

programs.title: Black Friday
programs.desc: After the 1993 Mumbai bomb blasts rip the city apart, the police force launches a massive drive to catch the perpetrators. Their relentless pressure finally results in some names coming forward.

programs.title: Phir Hera Pheri
programs.desc: The lives of three men changes overnight when they lose all the money they invested in a scam. Now, they must find another way to repay the dreaded loan sharks or face their death.
